rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person hired to show visitors around and explain a place.

example.english: This guide explains everything very clearly.
example.traditional: 呢個導遊講解得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dou6 jau4 gong2 gaai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Choose this for someone leading people through unfamiliar or hazardous terrain rather than showing them around a museum.

example.english: We hired a guide to lead the way on the hike.
example.traditional: 行山嗰陣，我哋請咗個嚮導帶路。
example.jyutping: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 cing2 zo2 go3 hoeng2 dou6 daai3 lou6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically leading someone along a route.

example.english: Please guide me to the MTR station.
example.traditional: 你幫我帶路去地鐵站啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 daai3 lou6 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 laa1

rows.note: Use this when leading people or a group, rather than simply showing someone a route.

example.english: The captain works to guide the whole team through the project.
example.traditional: 隊長帶領成隊人完成個計劃。
example.jyutping: deoi6 zoeng2 daai3 ling5 seng4 deoi6 jan4 jyun4 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this for a written guidebook or information guide, especially for travel or instructions.

example.english: I always read this guide before travelling.
example.traditional: 去旅行之前，我會先睇呢本指南。
example.jyutping: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zi1 cin4 ngo5 wui5 sin1 tai2 ni1 bun2 zi2 naam4

rows.note: Use this when guide means exert control or influence over a person, situation, or affair.

example.english: The rules guide how the team handles complaints.
example.traditional: 啲規矩控制住團隊點樣處理投訴。
example.jyutping: di1 gwai1 geoi2 hung3 zai3 zyu6 tyun4 deoi6 dim2 joeng6 cyu2 lei5 tau4 sou3

rows.note: Use this for piloting or steering a vehicle, ship, or aircraft.

example.english: I’m learning to guide a boat out to sea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hok6 gan2 gaa3 sai2 gaa3 syun4 ceot1 hoi2
